Recipients also benefit from three annual round-trip tickets during their studies.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>        <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Dr. Tod Laursen, Chancellor of AUS, underscored the significance of the scholarship, stating: "The President's Scholarship reflects our steadfast commitment to providing talented students from around the globe with access to an education that is both transformative and empowering."<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>        <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Students at AUS benefit from remarkable opportunities to engage in innovative research studies, thanks to the establishment of <a href="https://www.aus.edu/research-and-graduate-studies/research-centers" data-ylk="slk:six%20cutting-edge%20research%20centers;elm:context_link;itc:0;sec:content-canvas;source:content-canvas%20default" data-yga="{"yLinkText":"six cutting-edge research centers","yLinkElement":"context_link","yModuleName":"content-canvas","yTrafficOrigin":"content-canvas default"}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow">six cutting-edge research centers</a>. These include the Artificial Intelligence, Smart Infrastructure and Robotics Research Center; the Materials Research Center; the Center for Entrepreneurship, Innovation and Sustainable Development; the Energy, Water and Sustainable Environment Research Center; the Center for Arab Studies and Islamic Civilizations; and the Advanced Biosciences and Bioengineering Research Center.<!-- HTML_TAG_END -->  </p>    <div class="wrapper yf-wqkvlh" data-testid="inarticle-ad">   <div id="sda-INARTICLE-10ade9c1-a25c-3938-b13b-e9ea1b73ddde-2" class="sdaContainer  dv-all sda-INARTICLE-10ade9c1-a25c-3938-b13b-e9ea1b73ddde-2 yf-d5hqm1 overflow margin  visible placeholder" data-testid="ad-container" data-ad-unit="/22888152279/ca/yfin/ros/dt/ca_yfin_ros_dt_mid_center" data-ad-size="970x250,728x90,970x90,300x250" data-ad-region="main-dynamic" data-ad-loc="mid_center_2" style="--placeholder-height: 250px;"> </div></div>        <p class="text text-block paragraph text-left tight-spacing neo-font-paragraph-xl-reg  yf-18d6y07" style="text-decoration: none; font-style: normal; text-transform: none; text-align: inherit; font-variant-numeric: normal;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->Located in Sharjah, the cultural capital of the UAE, AUS combines tradition with modernity on a campus that inspires exploration and discovery.
